ApplyFreeCertificate.document:
When applying for a free certificate, if you need to apply through DNS delegation verification or file verification, you can call this API to initiate the certificate application and get the corresponding verification content based on the application method. The order in which to call the API is as follows:
Step 1: Call ApplyFreeCertificate to specify the verification method for the free certificate application and obtain the verification content.
Step 2: Configure the content for the corresponding domain as required for verification.
Step 3: Call CheckFreeCertificateVerification for verification. The free certificate application is completed after verification passes.
Step 4: Call ModifyHostsCertificate to configure the domain name certificate with an EdgeOne free certificate.

For the introduction to application methods, see the referenced document: Free Certificate Application Description (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/90437?from_cn_redirect=1) 
Description:
-Only the CNAME access mode can call this API to specify the free certificate application method. The NS/DNSPod hosting access mode uses automatic validation to apply for a free certificate, with no need to call this API.
-If you need to switch the verification method for a free certificate, you can call this API again to update it by changing the VerificationMethod field.
-A domain name can only apply for one free certificate. After calling this API, the backend will trigger the free certificate application task. You need to complete the domain name verification info configuration within 2 days, and then complete certificate authentication.
ApplyFreeCertificate.name: Applies for a free certificate

BindSecurityTemplateToEntity.document: Operate a security policy template. This API is used to bind or rebind a domain name to a designated policy template, or unbind it from a designated policy template.
BindSecurityTemplateToEntity.name: Binds or unbinds a security policy template

BindSharedCNAME.document: Used to bind or unbind a shared CNAME for an acceleration domain name. This feature is in beta test.
BindSharedCNAME.name: Binds a shared CNAME

BindZoneToPlan.document: Bind the selected site not bound to a package to an existing package.
BindZoneToPlan.name: Binds a package to a site

CheckCnameStatus.document:
When the site access type is CNAME, all domain names under the site must complete CNAME record configuration as specified by the CNAME domain assigned by EdgeOne.
This API is used to obtain the CNAME domain name assigned by EdgeOne for the integrated domain name, and to validate the CNAME configuration status of the integrated domain name.
CheckCnameStatus.name: Validates the CNAME configuration status of a domain

CheckFreeCertificateVerification.document:
This API is used to verify a free certificate and obtain the application result. If verification is passed, you can query the free certificate information for the corresponding domain through this API. If the application failed, this API will return the corresponding failure description.
After triggering the free certificate application API (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/90437?from_cn_redirect=1), you can check the free certificate application result through this API. Once the free certificate application is successful, you need to configure it through the domain certificate configuration API (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/80764?from_cn_redirect=1) to deploy the free certificate to the acceleration domain.
CheckFreeCertificateVerification.name: Checks the application result of a free certificate

ConfirmMultiPathGatewayOriginACL.document: This API is used to confirm that the latest origin-pull IP ranges have been updated to the origin server firewall when the origin-pull IP ranges of the multi-channel security acceleration gateway change.
ConfirmMultiPathGatewayOriginACL.name: Confirms the IP range update for the origin server of the multi-channel security acceleration gateway

ConfirmOriginACLUpdate.document: This API is used to confirm that the latest origin-pull IP ranges have been updated to the origin server firewall when the origin-pull IP ranges change. After confirming the update to the latest origin-pull IP ranges, related change notifications will stop being pushed.
ConfirmOriginACLUpdate.name: Confirms the origin-pull IP range update

CreateAccelerationDomain.document:
After creating a site, you can create an acceleration domain name through this API. 

In CNAME mode, if site ownership verification is ongoing, this API will return domain ownership verification info. You can verify domain ownership separately. For details, see [Site/Domain Name Ownership Verification](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/70789?from_cn_redirect=1).
CreateAccelerationDomain.name: Creates an acceleration domain name

CreateAliasDomain.document:
This API is used to create an alias domain name.
This feature is only supported in the enterprise plan and is currently in beta test. To use it, please [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).
CreateAliasDomain.name: Creates an alias domain name

CreateApplicationProxy.document: This API is on an earlier version. If you want to call it, switch to the latest version to create layer 4 proxy instances (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103417?from_cn_redirect=1).
CreateApplicationProxy.name: Creates an application proxy (legacy)

CreateApplicationProxyRule.document:
This API is on an earlier version. If you want to call it, switch to the latest version. For details, see [Create Layer 4 Proxy Forwarding Rule].
](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103416?from_cn_redirect=1) .
CreateApplicationProxyRule.name: Creates an application proxy rule (legacy)

CreateCLSIndex.document: This API is used to create key-value indexes for delivered log fields in the corresponding Tencent Cloud CLS log topic for a specified real-time log delivery task (task-id). If indexes have been created in CLS, this API will append indexes through merging.
CreateCLSIndex.name: Creates a CLS index

CreateConfigGroupVersion.document: In version management mode, this API is used to create a new version of a specified configuration group.
CreateConfigGroupVersion.name: Creates a configuration group version

CreateContentIdentifier.document: This API is used to create a content identifier. You can set the description, tag, and other information. At the same time, you need to bind an enterprise package for billing data statistics. A content identifier can only be bound to one billing package, while a billing package can bind multiple content identifiers. This functionality is only available to allowlisted users.
CreateContentIdentifier.name: Creates a content identifier

CreateCustomGroup.document: This API is used to create a custom group. A custom group is used to centrally manage a set of reusable matching entries. For example, you can save multiple JA3/JA4 TLS fingerprints as a TLS fingerprint group and directly reference the group in security rules, avoiding the need to maintain the same fingerprint list in multiple rules.
CreateCustomGroup.name: Creates a custom group

CreateCustomizeErrorPage.document: This API is used to create a custom response page.
CreateCustomizeErrorPage.name: Creates a custom response page

CreateDnsRecord.document: After a site is created and accessed in NS mode, you can create DNS records through this API.
CreateDnsRecord.name: Creates a DNS record

CreateEdgeKVNamespace.document: This API is used to create a KV namespace at a specified site.
CreateEdgeKVNamespace.name: Creates a KV namespace

CreateFunction.document: This API is used to create and deploy an edge function to EdgeOne edge nodes.
CreateFunction.name: Creates an edge function

CreateFunctionReplica.document: This API is used to create copies of a specified edge function. After creating copies, when client requests match the configured trigger rules or default domain name, you can access a specific function copy by adding EO-Function-Replica-Name:[copy name] to the request header. Each function supports creating two copies by default.
CreateFunctionReplica.name: Creates a replica of an edge function

CreateFunctionRule.document: Creates a trigger rule for an edge function. It supports customized filter conditions to determine whether to execute a function. When a function needs to be executed, multiple ways are provided to select the target function, including directly specifying, selecting based on the client's associated region, and weight-based selection.
CreateFunctionRule.name: Creates a trigger rule for an edge function

CreateInferenceAPIToken.document: Create an inference API Token for authentication when accessing the inference service. The Token content is returned only once when creating, and each site can create up to 100 tokens.
CreateInferenceAPIToken.name: Creates a reasoning API Token

CreateInferenceDomain.document:
Create an inference service domain name for accessing the inference service through a custom domain name. An inference service supports creating a maximum of 5 custom domain names.
After successful creation, complete the following steps to make the domain name function normally for external access:
1. To validate the CNAME configuration status of a domain, see the CheckCnameStatus api.
2. To verify ownership, refer to the VerifyOwnership API (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/1552/98879?from_cn_redirect=1);
3. To configure domain name certificates, refer to the ModifyHostsCertificate api.
CreateInferenceDomain.name: Creates a reasoning domain name

CreateInferenceService.document: This API is used to create an inference service. You can set the service name, listening port, container image configuration, and resource configuration. An access address is provided after successful creation.
CreateInferenceService.name: Creates an inference service

CreateJustInTimeTranscodeTemplate.document:
JIT transcoding already provides preset transcoding templates to meet most needs. For personalized transcoding requirements, you can create custom transcoding templates through this API, with up to 100 custom templates.
To ensure consistency of JIT transcoding effects and avoid video output exceptions caused by template changes during EO cache or M3U8 sharding, the template cannot be modified after creation.
To learn about JIT transcoding capacity, see EdgeOne Video Instant Processing Function Introduction (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/111927?from_cn_redirect=1).
CreateJustInTimeTranscodeTemplate.name: Creates a just in time transcoding template

CreateL4Proxy.document: This API is used to create a layer 4 proxy instance.
CreateL4Proxy.name: Creates a layer 4 proxy instance

CreateL4ProxyRules.document: This API is used to create Layer 4 proxy instance rules and supports individual and batch creation.
CreateL4ProxyRules.name: Creates a layer 4 proxy forwarding rule

CreateL7AccRules.document: This API is used to create rules in the [rule engine](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/70901?from_cn_redirect=1), with support for batch creation.
CreateL7AccRules.name: Creates an L7 acceleration rule

CreateLoadBalancer.document: This API is used to create a LoadBalancer. For details, see [Quickly Create Load Balancers](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/104223?from_cn_redirect=1). The load balancing feature is in beta test. If you need to use it, [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).
CreateLoadBalancer.name: Creates a LoadBalancer

CreateLogAnalysisDownloadTask.document:
This API is used to create a log analysis download task. After creation, you can query the download task through the DescribeLogAnalysisDownloadTasks API.
Note:
1. Supports up to 50 million log entries per download.
2. Log files will be retained for 3 days.
3. If multiple tasks exist at the same time, they will be processed sequentially based on task creation time.
CreateLogAnalysisDownloadTask.name: Creates log download tasks for log analysis

CreateMultiPathGateway.document: This API is used to create a multi-channel security acceleration gateway, including Cloud Gateway and Private Gateway. Use the DescribeMultiPathGateway interface to query the status. If the status is online, the creation succeeded.
CreateMultiPathGateway.name: Creates a multi-channel security acceleration gateway

CreateMultiPathGatewayLine.document: This API is used to create lines for integrating with the multi-channel security acceleration gateway, including EdgeOne Layer 4 proxy lines and custom lines.
CreateMultiPathGatewayLine.name: Creates a multi-channel security acceleration gateway line

CreateMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.document: This API is used to create a key for integrating with a multi-channel security acceleration gateway. Customers integrate with the multi-channel security acceleration gateway based on key signatures. Each site contains only one key, which can be used to integrate all gateways under the site. The key can be queried through the DescribeMultiPathGatewaySecretKey API.
CreateMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.name: Creates a multi-channel security acceleration gateway key

CreateOriginGroup.document: Create an origin server group to manage origin servers by group. The origin server group configured here can be referenced in features such as **adding an acceleration domain name** and **Layer 4 proxy**.
CreateOriginGroup.name: Creates an origin group

CreatePlan.document:
If you need to use the Edgeone product, you need to create a billing plan through this interface.
> After creating a package, you need to complete creating a site and binding the plan through [CreateZone](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/80719?from_cn_redirect=1) before Edgeone can provide services properly.
CreatePlan.name: Creates plan

CreatePlanForZone.document: Purchase a package for the selected site not bound to a package.
CreatePlanForZone.name: Purchases a package for the selected site

CreatePrefetchTask.document: This API is used to create a preheating task.
CreatePrefetchTask.name: This API is used to create a preheating task.

CreatePurgeTask.document:
When origin server resources update but the node cache TTL has not expired, users still access old resources. At this point, use this API to update node resources. The following two methods can trigger updates:
  • Direct deletion: Delete the node cache without any validation. User requests trigger origin-pull.
  • Mark expiration: Mark node resources as expired. User requests trigger back-to-origin validation, which sends HTTP conditional requests with If-None-Match and If-Modified-Since headers. If the origin server responds with 200, the node fetches new resources from the origin and updates the cache. If the origin server responds with 304, the cache will not be updated.
    • For details on purging cache tasks, see [Purge Cache](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/70759?from_cn_redirect=1).
CreatePurgeTask.name: Creates a cache purge task

CreateRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.document:
This API is used to create a real-time log delivery task. **Restrictions** An entity (a Layer 7 domain name, a Layer 4 proxy instance, or an Edge Function instance) under the same combination of `LogType` and `Area` can only have one task created for each `TaskType`. The mutual exclusion rules for different `LogType` values are as follows: | LogType | Conflicting TaskType | |---|---| | Layer 4 proxy logs, Edge Function execution logs | Choose one of `custom_endpoint`, `s3`, and `aws_s3` | When `TaskType` is `log_analysis`:
  • Only `LogType` = `l7-access-logs` or `web-attack` is supported.
  • Under the same combination of `ZoneId` and `Area`, only one task can be created for each `LogType`.
**Recommendation**: Before creating a task, call the [DescribeRealtimeLogDeliveryTasks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1145/59503) API to query existing tasks and avoid duplicate additions.
CreateRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.name: Creates a real-time log delivery task

CreateRule.document:
This API is on an earlier version for creating rule engine APIs. EdgeOne comprehensively upgraded the rule engine APIs on January 21, 2025. For details on the new API for creating layer-7 acceleration rules, refer to [CreateL7AccRules](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/115822?from_cn_redirect=1).

Note: Starting from January 21, 2025, the old version APIs will stop update and iteration. New features will only be provided by the latest version interface. The existing capacity supported by the old version APIs will not be affected. To avoid data field conflicts when using the old version APIs, migrate to the new version rule engine APIs as soon as possible.
CreateRule.name: Creates a rule of the rule engine (legacy)

CreateSecurityAPIService.document: Used to create an API service.
CreateSecurityAPIService.name: Creates an API service

CreateSecurityJSInjectionRule.document: This API is used to create JavaScript injection rules.
CreateSecurityJSInjectionRule.name: Creates a JavaScript injection rule

CreateSharedCNAME.document: Used to create a shared CNAME. This feature is in beta test.
CreateSharedCNAME.name: Creates a shared CNAME

CreateWebSecurityTemplate.document: Create a security policy configuration template
CreateWebSecurityTemplate.name: Creates a security policy configuration template

CreateZone.document:
EdgeOne offers three access methods: CNAME, NS, and domainless access. You need to finalize site creation through this API first. For CNAME and NS connected site scenarios, see [Quickly access EdgeOne from scratch](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/87601?from_cn_redirect=1). For domainless access scenarios, see [Quickly enable layer 4 proxy service](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/96051?from_cn_redirect=1).

> It is recommended to call this API to create a site when a package already exists under the account. Please input `PlanId` in the parameter to directly bind the site to the package. If `PlanId` is not input, the created site will be inactive and unable to provide normal services. You need to complete package binding through [BindZoneToPlan](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/83042?from_cn_redirect=1) before the site can provide services normally. If you currently have no bindable package, go to the console to purchase a package to finalize site creation.
CreateZone.name: Creates sites

DeleteAccelerationDomains.document: Delete acceleration domain names in batches.
DeleteAccelerationDomains.name: Delete acceleration domain names in batches.

DeleteAliasDomain.document:
Delete an alias domain name.
This feature is only supported in the enterprise plan and is currently in beta test. To use it, please [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).
DeleteAliasDomain.name: Deletes an alias domain name

DeleteApplicationProxy.document:
This API is on an earlier version. If you want to call it, switch to the latest version. For details, see Deleting a Layer 4 Proxy Instance.
](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103415?from_cn_redirect=1) .
DeleteApplicationProxy.name: Deletes an application proxy (legacy)

DeleteApplicationProxyRule.document: This API is on an earlier version. If you want to call it, switch to the latest version. For details, see Deleting L4 Proxy Rules (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103414?from_cn_redirect=1).
DeleteApplicationProxyRule.name: Deletes application proxy rule (legacy)

DeleteContentIdentifier.document: Delete the specified content identifier. The feature is open only in the allowlist.
DeleteContentIdentifier.name: Deletes a content identifier

DeleteCustomErrorPage.document: This API is used to delete a custom response page.
DeleteCustomErrorPage.name: Deletes a custom response page

DeleteCustomGroup.document: This API is used to delete a specified custom group. If the group is referenced by a rule, deletion is not allowed. Remove the reference first.
DeleteCustomGroup.name: Deletes a custom group

DeleteDnsRecords.document: You can use this API to delete DNS records in batches.
DeleteDnsRecords.name: Deletes DNS records in batches

DeleteEdgeKVNamespace.document: This API is used to delete a specified KV namespace. After deletion, all key-value pair data in the namespace will be cleared and cannot be recovered. If the namespace is referenced by an edge function, unbind the relationship before deletion.
DeleteEdgeKVNamespace.name: Deletes a KV namespace

DeleteFunction.document: This API is used to delete an edge function. Once deleted, the function cannot be recovered, and associated trigger rules, environment variables, and replicas are also deleted.
DeleteFunction.name: Deletes an edge function

DeleteFunctionReplica.document: This API is used to delete a specified edge function replica.
DeleteFunctionReplica.name: Deletes an edge function replica

DeleteFunctionRules.document: This API is used to delete a trigger rule for an edge function.
DeleteFunctionRules.name: Deletes a trigger rule for an edge function

DeleteInferenceAPIToken.document: Delete an inference API Token. Once deleted, the Token expires immediately, and requests using it to access the inference service will not pass authentication.
DeleteInferenceAPIToken.name: Deletes a reasoning API Token

DeleteJustInTimeTranscodeTemplates.document: Delete a just in time transcoding template based on the unique template identifier under the site ID.
DeleteJustInTimeTranscodeTemplates.name: Deletes a just in time transcoding template

DeleteL4Proxy.document: This API is used to delete a layer 4 proxy instance.
DeleteL4Proxy.name: Deletes a layer 4 proxy instance

DeleteL4ProxyRules.document: This API is used to delete l4 proxy rules and supports both individual and batch operation.
DeleteL4ProxyRules.name: Deletes l4 proxy rules

DeleteL7AccRules.document: This API is used to delete rules from the rule engine (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/70901?from_cn_redirect=1). Batch deletion supported.
DeleteL7AccRules.name: Deletes an L7 acceleration rule

DeleteLoadBalancer.document: This API is used to delete a load balancing instance. If the load balancing instance is referenced by other services, such as a Layer 4 proxy, it cannot be deleted. Remove the reference relationship first. The load balancer feature is in beta test. If you need to use it, contact us (https://www.tencentcloud.com/online?from_cn_redirect=1-service).
DeleteLoadBalancer.name: Deletes a LoadBalancer

DeleteMultiPathGateway.document: This API is used to delete multi-channel security acceleration gateways, including private gateways and Cloud Gateways.
DeleteMultiPathGateway.name: Deletes a multi-channel security acceleration gateway

DeleteMultiPathGatewayLine.document: This API is used to delete lines integrated with multi-channel security acceleration gateways. Only custom lines support deletion.
DeleteMultiPathGatewayLine.name: Deletes a multi-channel security acceleration gateway route

DeleteOriginGroup.document: Delete an origin group. If the origin group is still referenced by a service (for example, Layer 4 proxy, DNS, load balancing, or a rule), deletion is not allowed.
DeleteOriginGroup.name: Deletes an origin group

DeleteRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.document: This API is used to delete a real-time log delivery task.
DeleteRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.name: Deletes a real-time log delivery task

DeleteRules.document:
This API is on an earlier version for deleting rule engine APIs. EdgeOne completed a comprehensive upgrade of rule engine APIs on January 21, 2025. For details on the new API for deleting L7 acceleration rules, see [DeleteL7AccRules](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/115821?from_cn_redirect=1).

Note: Starting from January 21, 2025, the old version API will stop update and iteration. New features will only be provided in the new version API, and the existing capabilities supported by the old version API will not be affected. To avoid data field conflicts when using the old version API, migrate to the new version rule engine API as soon as possible.
DeleteRules.name: Deletes rule engine rules in batches (legacy)

DeleteSecurityAPIService.document: Used to delete an API service.
DeleteSecurityAPIService.name: Deletes an API service

DeleteSecurityIPGroup.document: Delete a specified IP group. If a rule references the IP group, deletion is not allowed.
DeleteSecurityIPGroup.name: Deletes a security IP group

DeleteSecurityJSInjectionRule.document: This API is used to delete JavaScript injection rules.
DeleteSecurityJSInjectionRule.name: Deletes a JavaScript injection rule

DeleteSharedCNAME.document: Used to delete a shared CNAME. This feature is in beta test.
DeleteSharedCNAME.name: Deletes a shared CNAME

DeleteWebSecurityTemplate.document: Delete a security policy configuration template
DeleteWebSecurityTemplate.name: Deletes a security policy configuration template

DeployConfigGroupVersion.document: In version management mode, this API is used for version release. You can release a version to the testing environment or production environment by EnvId. The version management feature is in beta test and currently only available to the allowlist.
DeployConfigGroupVersion.name: Publishes a configuration group version

DescribeAccelerationDomains.document: This API is used to view domain information under a site, including acceleration domain names, origin servers, and domain name status. You can view information of all domains under a site, or specify filter conditions to query specific domain information.
DescribeAccelerationDomains.name: Queries the acceleration domain name list

DescribeAliasDomains.document:
Query the list of alias domain names.
This feature is only supported in the enterprise plan and is currently in beta test. To use it, please [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).
DescribeAliasDomains.name: Queries the list of alias domain names

DescribeApplicationProxies.document: This API is on an earlier version. If you want to call it, switch to the latest version. The latest version splits into two APIs: one for querying the Layer 4 proxy instance list and the other for querying Layer 4 forwarding rules. For details, see [Query Layer 4 Proxy Instance List](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103413?from_cn_redirect=1) and [Query Layer 4 Proxy Forwarding Rule List](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/103412?from_cn_redirect=1).
DescribeApplicationProxies.name: Queries the application proxy list (legacy)

DescribeAvailableCustomActionsForRuleEng.document: Queries the list of available custom configurations for site rule engine operations.
DescribeAvailableCustomActionsForRuleEng.name: Queries the list of available custom configurations for the rule engine

DescribeAvailableOriginACLFamily.document:
This API is used to query detailed information about the origin protection IP range control domain, including the version number and specific IP range information. The main difference between standard control domain and streamlined control domain is the number of IP ranges provided. The latter has fewer IP ranges, but has some usage restrictions. For specific restrictions, consult the product. The format description is as follows: Standard control domain:
  • gaz: standard global control domain;
  • mlc: Standard China control domain;
  • emc: standard overseas (worldwide excluding China) control domain;
    • Streamline the control domain.
  • plat-gaz: simplified global control domain;
  • plat-mlc: Simplified China control domain;
  • plat-emc: Simplified overseas (global excluding China) control domain;
  • plat-specific-gaz: custom edition global availability zone control domain;
  • plat-specific-mlc: custom edition for controlling the Chinese mainland availability zone control domain;
  • plat-specific-emc: custom edition control domain for availability zones worldwide (excluding Chinese mainland);
    • Abbreviation description:
  • gaz:Global AZ Availability Zone;
  • mlc:mainlandChina;
  • emc:Exclude mainlandChina.
DescribeAvailableOriginACLFamily.name: Queries the configurable control domain information list for origin protection

DescribeAvailablePlans.document: Query the list of available package information for the current account.
DescribeAvailablePlans.name: Queries the list of packages available for purchase by the current account

DescribeBillingData.document: Query billing data via this API.
DescribeBillingData.name: Queries billing data

DescribeConfigGroupVersionDetail.document: In version management mode, this API is used to obtain detailed version information, including version ID, description, status, creation time, associated configuration group information, and the content of the version configuration file. The version management feature is in beta test and currently only available to the allowlist.
DescribeConfigGroupVersionDetail.name: Queries configuration group version details

DescribeConfigGroupVersions.document: In version management mode, this API is used to query the version list of a specified configuration group. The version management feature is in beta test and currently only available to the allowlist.
DescribeConfigGroupVersions.name: Queries the configuration group version list

DescribeContentIdentifiers.document: This API is used to query content identifiers in batches. They can be filtered by ID, description, status, or tags. Deleted content identifiers queried by status are only retained for three months. This feature is only open in the allowlist.
DescribeContentIdentifiers.name: Batch queries content identifiers

DescribeContentQuota.document: Query the content management API quota
DescribeContentQuota.name: Queries content management API quota

DescribeCustomErrorPages.document: This API is used to query the custom error page list.
DescribeCustomErrorPages.name: Queries the list of custom response pages

DescribeCustomGroup.document: This API is used to query the detailed information of a custom group, including all entries in the group (returned with pagination via Limit/Offset). The DescribeCustomGroups list API returns up to the first 500 entries for each group. To obtain all entries, use this API. The GroupId can be obtained from the response of CreateCustomGroup or by querying DescribeCustomGroups.
DescribeCustomGroup.name: Queries custom groups

DescribeCustomGroupReferences.document: This API is used to obtain the security policy configuration that uses a custom group.
DescribeCustomGroupReferences.name: Queries custom group reference information

DescribeCustomGroups.document: This API is used to query the list of custom groups under a specified site. This API returns only the first 500 entries of each custom group. To query all entries in a group, use the DescribeSecurityCustomGroup API.
DescribeCustomGroups.name: Queries the custom group list

DescribeDDoSAttackData.document: This API is used to query DDoS attack time-series data.
DescribeDDoSAttackData.name: Queries DDoS attack time-series data

DescribeDDoSAttackEvent.document: This API is used to query the list of DDoS attack events.
DescribeDDoSAttackEvent.name: Queries the DDoS attack event list

DescribeDDoSAttackTopData.document: This API is used to query Top-ranked data of DDoS attacks.
DescribeDDoSAttackTopData.name: Queries Top-ranked DDoS attack data

DescribeDDoSProtection.document: This API is used to query exclusive DDoS protection info of a site.
DescribeDDoSProtection.name: Queries the exclusive DDoS protection information of a site

DescribeDefaultCertificates.document:
Query the default certificate list

Note: This earlier version interface is no longer updated. New features will only be provided in the latest version interface. Existing capacities supported by the earlier version interface will not be affected. To query the cert configured for a domain name, please use DescribeAccelerationDomains.
DescribeDefaultCertificates.name: Queries the default certificate list (legacy)

DescribeDeployHistory.document: In version management mode, this API is used to query the version release history of production/test environments. The version management feature is in beta test and currently only available to the allowlist.
DescribeDeployHistory.name: Queries version release history

DescribeDnsRecords.document: This API is used to view DNS records under a site, including DNS record names, record types, and record content. It supports specifying filter conditions to query specific DNS records.
DescribeDnsRecords.name: Queries the DNS record list

DescribeEdgeKVNamespaces.document: Queries the KV namespace list under a specified site. Supports pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering. Returns basic namespace info, storage capacity utilization, and reference relationships. If no data is found, an empty array is returned.
DescribeEdgeKVNamespaces.name: Queries KV Namespaces

DescribeEnvironments.document: In version management mode, this API is used to query environment information, including the environment ID, type, and current effective version. The version management feature is in beta test and currently only available to the allowlist.
DescribeEnvironments.name: Querying Environment Information

DescribeFunctionComponentBindings.document: This API is used to query the component binding list of a specified edge function. It supports pagination and conditional filtering, and returns detailed information such as the bound component type, variable name, and configuration parameters. The currently supported binding component type is KV namespace (kv_namespace).
DescribeFunctionComponentBindings.name: Queries the function component bound list

DescribeFunctionReplicas.document: This API is used to query the replica list of edge functions.
DescribeFunctionReplicas.name: Queries the list of edge function replicas

DescribeFunctionRules.document: This API is used to query the list of trigger rules for an edge function. It supports filtering by rule ID, function ID, rule description, and so on.
DescribeFunctionRules.name: Queries a trigger rule for an edge function

DescribeFunctionRuntimeEnvironment.document: This API is used to query the runtime environment of an edge function, including environment variables.
DescribeFunctionRuntimeEnvironment.name: Queries the runtime environment of an edge function

DescribeHostsSetting.name: Queries detailed domain configuration (legacy)

DescribeIPGroupReferences.document: This API is used to obtain policy settings that use IP grouping.

DescribeIPRegion.document: This API is used to query if the IP is an EdgeOne IP.

DescribeIdentifications.document: Queries verification information of a site.
DescribeIdentifications.name: Queries verification information of a site

DescribeInferenceAPITokens.document: Queries the list of reasoning API tokens and returns the Token ID, name, content, and creation time. Paging query is supported.
DescribeInferenceAPITokens.name: Queries a reasoning API Token

DescribeInferenceDomains.document: This API is used to query the inference service domain name list and return the Cname address, ownership verification, and certificate information of the domain.
DescribeInferenceDomains.name: Queries the list of inference service domain names

DescribeInferenceHardwareSpecifications.document: This API is used to query the inference hardware specification list and return the CPU, memory, GPU, and video memory configurations of each specification. You can select the required specification from the list when creating a service.
DescribeInferenceHardwareSpecifications.name: Queries the reasoning hardware specification list

DescribeInferenceServiceDeploymentLogs.name: Queries the deployment log of an inference service

DescribeLoadBalancerList.document: This API is used to query the load balancing instance list. The load balancer feature is in beta test. If you need to use it, [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).

DescribeMultiPathGatewayLine.document: This API is used to query lines connected to the multi-channel security acceleration gateway, including direct connections, EdgeOne Layer 4 proxy lines, and custom lines.

DescribeMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.document: This API is used to query the key for integrating a multi-channel security acceleration gateway. Customers sign with the integration key to access the multi-channel security acceleration gateway.

EnableOriginACL.document:
This API is used to enable origin protection for a site for the first time. After it is enabled, EdgeOne will use specific origin-pull IP ranges to pull from the origin for layer-7 acceleration domains/layer-4 proxy instances. This API supports two modes: **Automatic Protection Mode** and **Specified Protection Mode**.
  • When **Automatic Protection Mode** is used (L7EnableMode/L4EnableMode is set to all), the acceleration domain list and layer-4 proxy instances under the site will be automatically added to the origin protection list in real time without manual intervention;
  • When **Specified Protection Mode** is used (L7EnableMode/L4EnableMode is set to specific), you need to manually specify the resources to be added to origin protection. Unspecified resources will not be added to the origin protection list. If resource adjustment is required, you need to actively call the ModifyOriginACL API to make adjustments.
    • Instructions for using the Specified Protection Mode:
  • The maximum number of layer-7 acceleration domains that can be submitted at a time is 200, and the maximum number of layer-4 proxy instances is 100. Mixed submission of layer-7 acceleration domains/layer-4 proxy instances is supported, with a maximum total of 200 instances;
  • When more than 200 resources need to be enabled, you need to first configure the resources of the first shard through this API, and then configure the remaining shards through the ModifyOriginACL API. For example, if 500 layer-7 acceleration domains need to be added, first use this API to set 200 domains, and then use the ModifyOriginACL API to configure the remaining 300 domains in two batches, with no more than 200 domains per batch.
    • Note: - When enabling, accounts on the allowlist can select other origin-pull IP range versions, such as the simplified version, to achieve the effect of pulling from the origin with fewer IP ranges. - Calling this API is deemed as your agreement to the [Special Agreement on Enabling Origin Protection](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/120141?from_cn_redirect=1); - Origin-pull IP ranges are subject to change from time to time. EdgeOne will send notifications 14 days, 7 days, 3 days, and 1 day before the change through one or more methods such as in-site messages, SMS, and emails. To ensure that you can receive notifications of origin-pull IP range changes, make sure that you have selected message notifications related to the EdgeOne product in the [Tencent Cloud Message Center Console](https://console.cloud.tencent.com/message) and configured the correct message recipients. For configuration methods, refer to [Message Subscription Management](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/567/43476?from_cn_redirect=1).
EnableOriginACL.name: Enables origin protection

ModifyMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.document: This API is used to modify the key for integrating a multi-channel security acceleration gateway. Customers sign with the integration key to access the multi-channel security acceleration gateway. After modification, the original key becomes invalid.
ModifyMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.name: Modifies the integration key of a multi-channel security acceleration gateway

ModifyMultiPathGatewayStatus.document: This API is used to update the multi-channel security gateway status.
ModifyMultiPathGatewayStatus.name: Modifies multi-channel security acceleration gateway status

ModifyOriginACL.document:
This API is used to modify the origin protection configuration of a site. The following operations are supported:
  • **Resource addition and deletion**: enable or disable origin-pull from specific origin IP ranges for layer-7 accelerated domains/layer-4 proxy instances. This applies to resource adjustment in **specified protection mode**, and unspecified resources will not change;
  • **Mode switching**: adjust the origin protection mode of layer-7 accelerated domains/layer-4 proxy instances. After switching to all, the list of accelerated domains or layer-4 proxy instances under the site will be automatically added to the origin protection list in real time, and subsequent resource changes will also be automatically adjusted without manual intervention; after switching to specific, only the mode is changed, and resources already included in protection remain unchanged;
  • **IP range version switching**: for whitelisted customers, it supports switching to other available origin protection IP range versions, such as the simplified version, to reduce origin-pull IP ranges.
    • Instructions for specified protection mode:
  • The maximum number of layer-7 accelerated domains that can be submitted at a time is 200, and the maximum number of layer-4 proxy instances is 100. Mixed submission of layer-7 accelerated domains/layer-4 proxy instances is supported, with a maximum total of 200 instances;
  • When more than 200 resources need to be changed, submit them in batches through this API. For example, to add 500 layer-7 accelerated domains, first submit 200 domains through this API, and then submit the remaining 300 domains in two batches, with no more than 200 domains each time.
ModifyOriginACL.name: Modifies origin protection instances

ModifyOriginGroup.document: Modify origin group configuration. Newly submitted origin records will overwrite the original origin records in the origin group.
ModifyOriginGroup.name: Modifies an origin group

ModifyPlan.document: Modify the plan settings. Currently, only the auto-renewal switch of prepaid plans can be modified.
ModifyPlan.name: Modifies plan setting

ModifyPrefetchOriginLimit.document:
This API is used to configure origin-pull rate limiting. This feature is in allowlist beta test.
This API is used to create, modify, and delete preheated origin-pull rate limits. Each account supports up to 100 limits.
ModifyPrefetchOriginLimit.name: Configures preheating origin-pull rate limiting

ModifyRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.document:
This API is used to modify the configuration of a real-time log delivery task. It has the following limits:
  • The destination type (`TaskType`) of a real-time log delivery task cannot be modified;
  • The data delivery type (`LogType`) cannot be modified;
  • The data delivery region (`Area`) cannot be modified;
  • When the destination of the original real-time log delivery task is Tencent Cloud CLS, the destination details such as the log set and log topic cannot be modified.
ModifyRealtimeLogDeliveryTask.name: Modifies a real-time log delivery task

ModifyRule.document:
This API is on an earlier version for modifying rule engine APIs. EdgeOne comprehensively upgraded rule engine-related APIs on January 21, 2025. For details on the new version API for modifying layer-7 acceleration rules, refer to [ModifyL7AccRule](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/115818?from_cn_redirect=1).

Note: Starting from January 21, 2025, the legacy version API will stop update and iteration. New features will only be provided in the latest version API. The existing capacity supported by the legacy version API will not be affected. To avoid data field conflict when using the legacy version API, migrate to the latest version rule engine API as soon as possible.
ModifyRule.name: Modifies a rule of the rule engine (legacy)

ModifySecurityAPIResource.document: This API is used to modify API resources.
ModifySecurityAPIResource.name: Modifies an API resource

ModifySecurityAPIService.document: This API is used to modify API services.
ModifySecurityAPIService.name: Modifies an API service

ModifySecurityJSInjectionRule.document: This API is used to modify JavaScript injection rules.
ModifySecurityJSInjectionRule.name: Modifies JavaScript injection rules

ModifySharedCNAME.document: This API is used to modify a shared CNAME. Currently, it only supports modifying the description and settings of a shared CNAME, and associating an IP SSL domain name with an IP SSL shared CNAME. Once created, a shared CNAME itself cannot be modified. This feature is in beta test.
ModifySharedCNAME.name: Modifies a shared CNAME

ModifyWebSecurityTemplate.document: Modifies a security policy configuration template
ModifyWebSecurityTemplate.name: Modifies a security policy configuration template

ModifyZoneCustomVariables.document:
This API is used to manage site-level custom variables, supporting the creation, modification, and deletion of variable definitions and variable operations. The submitted list will override the corresponding existing configuration. To clear the configuration, pass in an empty list. Configuration items not passed in remain unchanged. The default values for variable definitions and variable operations are both empty.

For rule-level custom variable related operations, call the CreateL7AccRules or ModifyL7AccRule API.

ModifyZoneSetting.document: This API is on an earlier version. EdgeOne has completed a comprehensive upgrade of rule engine APIs. For details, see [ModifyL7AccSetting](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/115817?from_cn_redirect=1).
ModifyZoneSetting.name: Modifies site configuration (legacy)

ModifyZoneStatus.document: Used to enable or disable a site.
ModifyZoneStatus.name: Switches site status

ModifyZoneWorkMode.document: This API is used to modify the working mode of each configuration module under a site. Each configuration module of a site can enable version management mode or immediate effect mode by configuration group dimension. For details, see Version Management (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/113690?from_cn_redirect=1).
ModifyZoneWorkMode.name: Modifies site working mode

OperateInferenceDomain.document: Operate an inference service domain name. You can stop, enable, and delete it. Resources cannot be recovered after deletion.
OperateInferenceDomain.name: Operates an inference service domain name

OperateInferenceService.document: Operate an inference service. You can stop, start, and delete it. Resources cannot be recovered after deletion.
OperateInferenceService.name: Operates an inference service

RefreshMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.document: This API is used to refresh the key of a multi-channel security acceleration gateway. Customers integrate with the multi-channel security acceleration gateway based on key signatures. Each site contains only one key, which can be used to integrate all gateways under the site. After the key is refreshed, the original key becomes invalid.
RefreshMultiPathGatewaySecretKey.name: Refreshes the key of a multi-channel security acceleration gateway

RenewPlan.document:
When your plan needs to be extended, you can use this API to renew it. Plan renewal is only supported for the Personal, Basic, and Standard Editions.
> For cost details, refer to [Plan Cost](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/94158?from_cn_redirect=1).
RenewPlan.name: Renews plan

UpgradePlan.document:
When you need features available only in higher-tier plans, you can upgrade your plan through this interface. Upgrades are only supported for Personal and Basic Edition Plans.
> For differences between different types of Edgeone billing plans, see Edgeone billing plan comparison (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/94165?from_cn_redirect=1)
For billing package upgrade rules and pricing details, see Edgeone billing package upgrade instructions (https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/95291?from_cn_redirect=1)
If your plan needs to upgrade to the Enterprise Edition, please [contact us](https://www.tencentcloud.com/contact-us).
UpgradePlan.name: Upgrades plan

VerifyOwnership.document:
In CNAME access mode, you need to verify the ownership of the site or domain name. This API is used to trigger the verification. If the site passes ownership verification, no need to verify again when adding domains subsequently. For details, see [Site/Domain Name Ownership Verification](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/70789?from_cn_redirect=1).

In NS access mode, you can also query through this API whether the NS server switch is successful. For details, see [Modify DNS Server](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1552/90452?from_cn_redirect=1).
VerifyOwnership.name: Verifies ownership

AllowActionParameters.document:
Additional parameter when the executed action is allow. This parameter is used to specify the extra handling action taken by the system when a security rule is hit and the Allow action is executed. Different handling actions are configured with different fixed parameter combinations. The system will determine the actually effective handling action type according to the configured parameter combination. During the same release execution, only one handling action can be configured and made effective. Parameters for multiple handling actions cannot appear at the same time. Otherwise, it is deemed as an invalid configuration. If empty, the default release action is used. AllowActionParameters supports the following additional handling actions:
  • Default: When AllowActionParameters is empty, immediately skip the remaining rules of the current security module and continue matching subsequent security modules.
  • Delayed release: Add response delay to the request and continue matching the remaining rules of the current module. Corresponding parameters: MinDelayTime, MaxDelayTime.

ChallengeActionParameters.document:
Additional parameter for the safe execution action when it is a challenge. This parameter is used to specify the extra handling action taken by the system when a security rule is hit and a challenge action is executed. Challenge disposal actions are segmented through ChallengeOption. Different challenge types correspond to different interaction forms and parameter requirements. The system will bring the corresponding parameter configuration into effect according to the selected challenge type. ChallengeActionParameters supports the following challenge disposition types:
  • Interstitial challenge: responds with a new page and runs the authentication mechanism within the new page. The corresponding ChallengeOption value is InterstitialChallenge.
  • Inline challenge: responds with an SDK challenge. The corresponding ChallengeOption value is InlineChallenge.
  • JavaScript challenge: invisible verification in the browser. The browser automatically performs verification and shows the requested resource. The corresponding ChallengeOption value is JSChallenge.
  • Managed challenge: responds with a redirect page containing a JavaScript program, used for verification of the browser runtime environment. The corresponding ChallengeOption value is ManagedChallenge.

members.document:
Specific challenge action for safe execution.

Enumeration values:

  • InterstitialChallenge: Interstitial challenge;
  • InlineChallenge: Embedded challenge (SDK challenge);
  • ManagedChallenge: Managed challenge. Applicable only to HTML web pages directly accessed by users through a browser. API interfaces, XHR/AJAX asynchronous requests within web pages, mobile apps, command line tools, and other scenarios cannot complete the verification. Do not configure;
  • JSChallenge: JavaScript challenge. Applicable only to HTML web pages directly accessed by users through a browser. API interfaces, XHR/AJAX asynchronous requests within web pages, mobile apps, command line tools, and other scenarios cannot complete the verification. Do not configure.
members.name: ChallengeOption

DeliveryCondition.document: Real-time log delivery conditions, used to define the scope of delivered logs. Multiple items in the `DeliveryCondition` array are in an "OR" relationship, and multiple items in the inner `Conditions` array are in an "AND" relationship.

members.document:
Log filter conditions. The supported conditions are as follows:

  • `EdgeResponseStatusCode`: filters by the status code that the EdgeOne node returns to the client.
    • Supported operators: `equal`, `great`, `less`, `great_equal`, `less_equal`
    • Value range: any integer greater than or equal to 0
  • `OriginResponseStatusCode`: filters by the status code returned by the origin server.
    • Supported operators: `equal`, `great`, `less`, `great_equal`, `less_equal`
    • Value range: any integer greater than or equal to -1
  • `SecurityAction`: filters by the final action taken after the request hits a security rule.
    • Supported operators: `equal`
    • Valid values:
      • `-`: unknown or no rule hit
      • `Monitor`: Monitor
      • `JSChallenge`: JavaScript Challenge
      • `Deny`: Deny
      • `Allow`: Allow
      • `BlockIP`: Block IP
      • `Redirect`: Redirect
      • `ReturnCustomPage`: Return custom page
      • `ManagedChallenge`: Managed Challenge
      • `Silence`: Silence
      • `LongDelay`: Respond after a long delay
      • `ShortDelay`: Respond after a short delay
  • `SecurityModule`: filters by the name of the security module that finally handled the request.
    • Supported operators: `equal`
    • Valid values:
      • `-`: unknown or no rule hit
      • `CustomRule`: Web Security - Custom Rules
      • `RateLimitingCustomRule`: Web Security - Rate Limiting Rules
      • `ManagedRule`: Web Security - Managed Rules
      • `L7DDoS`: Web Security - CC Attack Defense
      • `BotManagement`: Bot Management - Basic Bot Management
      • `BotClientReputation`: Bot Management - Client Reputation Analysis
      • `BotBehaviorAnalysis`: Bot Management - Intelligent Bot Analysis
      • `BotCustomRule`: Bot Management - Custom Bot Rules
      • `BotActiveDetection`: Bot Management - Active Detection
members.name: Conditions

DenyActionParameters.document:
Additional parameter for the safe execution action when it is interception. This parameter is used to specify the extra handling action taken by the system when a security rule is hit and an intercept action is executed. Different handling actions are configured with different fixed parameter combinations. The system will determine the actually effective handling action type according to the configured parameter combination. Only one handling action can be configured and made effective during the same block execution. Parameters corresponding to multiple handling actions cannot appear simultaneously, otherwise the configuration is deemed invalid. If empty, the default block handling action is used. DenyActionParameters supports the following extra handling actions:
  • Default: When DenyActionParameters is empty or no extra handling action is enabled, the system will perform the default block, responding with an interception page.
  • IP blocking: Continuously block the client source IP that triggers the rule. Corresponding parameters: BlockIp, BlockIpDuration.
  • Custom page interception: Use the specified custom page content to respond to requests. Corresponding parameters: ReturnCustomPage, ResponseCode, ErrorPageId.
  • Silence: Accept client requests but do not return. Corresponding parameter: Stall.

members.document:
Whether to extend the block on the source IP. Valid values:
  • `on`: Enable;
  • off: Disable.
    • After enabled, the client IP that triggers the rule will be continuously blocked. When this option is enabled, the BlockIpDuration parameter must be specified simultaneously. Note: This option cannot intersect with ReturnCustomPage or Stall.
members.name: BlockIp

members.document: IP ban duration when BlockIP is on.
members.name: BlockIpDuration

members.document:
Whether to use custom pages. Valid values:
  • `on`: Enable;
  • off: Disable.
    • Enabled. Use custom page content to intercept (respond to) requests. When this option is enabled, you must specify the ResponseCode and ErrorPageId parameters simultaneously. Note: This option cannot intersect with BlockIp or Stall.
members.name: ReturnCustomPage

members.document:
Whether to suspend requests from the request source without processing. Valid values:
  • `on`: Enable;
  • off: Disable.
    • Enabled. It no longer responds to requests in the current connection session and does not actively disconnect. When used for crawler counteraction, it consumes client connection resources. Note: This option cannot intersect with BlockIp or ReturnCustomPage.

Statistical query statement, composed of [retrieval criteria] | [SQL statement]. The SQL segment after the pipe character "|" is required. The retrieval criteria segment can be empty (for example, | SELECT ...), which means aggregation on full data. Maximum length: 12 KB. Default SQL Limit: 100. Maximum Limit: 10000.
Example:

With retrieval criteria: ${EdgeCacheStatus} in ['miss','other'] | select EdgeCacheStatus as status, count(*) as cnt group by status limit 2

Without retrieval criteria: | select EdgeCacheStatus as status, count(*) as cnt group by status
members.example: ${EdgeCacheStatus} in ['miss','other'] | select EdgeCacheStatus as status, count(*) as cnt group by status limit 2

Column names in the log analysis statistical result, corresponding to the fields in the SELECT part of the SQL in the input parameter Query.

Input parameter Query = ${EdgeCacheStatus} in ['miss','other'] | SELECT EdgeCacheStatus as status, count(*) as cnt group by status limit 2
Output parameter Columns = ["status","cnt"]

members.document:
Rows of data in the log analysis statistics result. The value index in each row corresponds one-to-one with the column index.

Records = [["miss","9695"],["other","278"]]

List of binding relationships of the specified policy template.

When a domain name in a site is included in the binding relationship of a specified policy template, the binding relationship list `TemplateScope` will include the `ZoneId` of the site and the domain name binding relationships under the site related to the policy template.

Note: When no any domain name is being bound or has been bound to the specified policy template, the binding relationship is empty. That is, in the return structure, the length of the `TemplateScope` array is 0.

In a binding relationship, the same domain name may appear repeatedly in the `EntityStatus` list and be marked with different `Status`. For example, a domain name being bound to another policy template is marked as both `online` and `pending` at the same time.

  • CNAME: Point the domain to another domain, which then resolves the final IP;
  • TXT: Identifies and describes a domain name, commonly used for domain name verification and SPF records (anti-spam);
  • NS: If you need to delegate subdomain resolution to another DNS service provider, you need to add an NS record. NS records cannot be added for the root domain;
  • CAA: specify the CA that can issue certificates for this site;
  • SRV: identifies that a server used a service, commonly seen in directory management of Microsoft systems.

Probe request Host Header policy. It takes effect only when Type=HTTP or Type=HTTPS and the instance type is HTTP-dedicated (V2). Valid values:

  • FollowCheckURL: Follows the Host specified by the probe URL, that is, the Host part in the HealthChecker.Path field will be used as the Host address for probing;
  • FollowOriginGroup: Follows the origin-pull Host Header configured in the origin group, that is, the OriginGroup.HostHeader field value of the origin group where the probed origin resides will be used as the Host address for probing. If the origin group has no HostHeader configured, the Host part in the HealthChecker.Path field will be used as the Host address for probing;
  • FollowOrigin: Follows the origin address, that is, the OriginGroup.Records[N].Record field value (the origin address itself) of the corresponding origin record in the origin group where the probed origin resides will be used as the Host address for probing.

Health check probe cluster. Specifies the cluster region scope from which this load balancer instance initiates health probes. For details on the regional distribution of probe clusters, see Health Check Policy Introduction. This can be configured only for HTTP-dedicated (V2) load balancer instances. Valid values:

  • global: Probes are initiated by probe clusters in all regions worldwide, including the Chinese mainland and regions outside the Chinese mainland. Clusters in each region independently maintain their own probe results;
  • mainland_china: Probes are initiated only by probe clusters in the Chinese mainland. Currently, the Chinese mainland shares one probe cluster, and probe results are maintained by the probe cluster in the Chinese mainland. Other regions follow the probe results of the cluster in the Chinese mainland;
  • overseas: Probes are initiated only by probe clusters in regions outside the Chinese mainland. Currently, regions outside the Chinese mainland contain probe clusters in multiple areas, and probe results are independently maintained by the probe clusters in each area. Probe results for the Chinese mainland are generated by aggregating the probe results of the probe clusters in all other areas.

You can directly use the specified predefined log output format (JSON Lines / csv) through the FormatType parameter, or define a variant output format through additional parameters based on the predefined log output format. Log output format. Valid values:

Origin protection mode for layer-7 accelerated domains. Default value: specific.

  • all: Automatic protection mode. All layer-7 accelerated domains in the site will be automatically added to the origin protection list, including newly added layer-7 accelerated domains;
  • specific: Manual protection mode. You need to manually specify the layer-7 accelerated domains to be added to origin protection (specified by the L7Hosts parameter). Resources not specified will not be added to the origin protection list. Subsequent protection resource adjustments can be made through the ModifyOriginACL API.
    • Note: When the value is all, leave L7Hosts empty; when the number of layer-7 accelerated domains under the site exceeds 200, enable protection in specific mode first, enable the remaining resources through the ModifyOriginACL API, and then switch to all through the ModifyOriginACL API.
members.name: L7EnableMode

members.document:
Origin protection mode for layer-4 proxy instances. Default value: specific.

  • all: Automatic protection mode. All layer-4 proxy instances in the site will be automatically added to the origin protection list, including newly added layer-4 proxy instance resources;
  • specific: Manual protection mode. You need to manually specify the layer-4 proxy instances to be added to origin protection (specified by the L4ProxyIds parameter). Resources not specified will not be added to the origin protection list. Subsequent protection resource adjustments can be made through the ModifyOriginACL API.
    • Note: When the value is all, leave L4ProxyIds empty; when the number of layer-4 proxy instances under the site exceeds 100, enable protection in specific mode first, enable the remaining resources through the ModifyOriginACL API, and then switch to all through the ModifyOriginACL API.
members.name: L4EnableMode

members.document:
Instances for which origin-pull from specific origin IP ranges needs to be enabled or disabled.
Note: This parameter is only applicable to resource adjustment in Manual protection mode; When the origin protection mode of the corresponding level is all, the resource list of this type is automatically maintained by the system. Do not include resources of this type in this parameter. For manual adjustment, switch the corresponding level to specific through L7EnableMode/L4EnableMode first.

Specific values are described as follows:

  • mlc: Standard Chinese mainland AZ control domain;
  • emc: Standard global (excluding Chinese mainland) AZ control domain;
  • plat-gaz: Simplified global AZ control domain;
  • plat-mlc: Simplified Chinese mainland AZ control domain;
  • plat-emc: Simplified global (excluding Chinese mainland) AZ control domain;

  • When OriginType = LoadBalance, specify the Cloud Load Balancer instance ID. This feature is currently only available to the allowlist. Operation type. Valid values:
  • append: Add a new IP address to the IPGroup or set a scheduled expiration time;
  • remove: Delete a specified IP address or its scheduled expiration time from the IPGroup;
  • update: Replace all content in Content or ExpireInfo of the IPGroup, and modifications to the name of the IPGroup are allowed.
    • Notes for the append operation:
  • When adding a scheduled expiration time for an IP or range, it must be later than the current time. If the IP or range does not exist in the group, you must add it in the Content parameter simultaneously. If the IP or range already has an expiration time, the new time will override the original time.
    • Notes for the remove operation:
  • When deleting an IP or range, related unexpired scheduled expiration times will also be deleted;
  • When deleting a scheduled expiration time, you can only delete a time that is not expired.
    • Notes for the update operation:
  • When replacing the content of Content, unexpired times of IPs or ranges not in Content will be deleted;
  • When replacing the content of IPExpireInfo, the IPs or ranges in IPExpireInfo must be in Content or exist in the IP group.

RequestFieldsForException.document: Skipped field configuration in the exception rule

members.document:
Specific fields to skip. Supported values:
  • body.json: parameter content in JSON requests. At this point, Condition supports key and value, and TargetField supports key and value. For example, { "Scope": "body.json", "Condition": "", "TargetField": "key" } means ALL parameters in the JSON request content skip WAF scan.
  • cookie: Cookie; at this point, Condition supports key and value, and TargetField supports key and value, for example { "Scope": "cookie", "Condition": "${key} in ['account-id'] and ${value} like ['prefix-*']", "TargetField": "value" }, which means the cookie parameter name equals account-id and the parameter value wildcard matches prefix-* to skip WAF scan;
  • header: HTTP header parameters. At this point, Condition supports key and value, and TargetField supports key and value. For example, { "Scope": "header", "Condition": "${key} like ['x-auth-*']", "TargetField": "value" } means the header parameter name wildcard match x-auth-* skips WAF scan.
  • uri.query: URL-encoded content/query parameters. At this point, Condition supports key and value, and TargetField supports key and value. For example, { "Scope": "uri.query", "Condition": "${key} in ['action'] and ${value} in ['upload', 'delete']", "TargetField": "value" } means the parameter name of the URL-encoded content/query parameters is equal to action and the parameter value is equal to upload or delete, skip WAF scan;
  • uri: request path URI. At this point, Condition must be empty, and TargetField supports query, path, and fullpath. For example, { "Scope": "uri", "Condition": "", "TargetField": "query" } means only query parameters in the request path URI skip WAF scan.
  • body: request body content. At this point, Condition must be empty, and TargetField supports fullbody and multipart, for example { "Scope": "body", "Condition": "", "TargetField": "fullbody" }, which means the request body content is the complete request body and skips WAF scan;
members.name: Scope

members.document:
Expression of the specific field to skip, which must comply with the expression grammar.
Condition supports expression configuration syntax:
  • Write the filter condition expression syntax based on the rule, with support for referencing key and value.
  • Support in and like operators, and logical combination with and.
    • For example:
  • ${key} in ['x-trace-id']: The parameter name is equal to x-trace-id.
  • ${key} in ['x-trace-id'] and ${value} like ['Bearer *']: The parameter name is equal to x-trace-id and the parameter value wildcard matches Bearer *.
members.name: Condition

members.document:
When the Scope parameter takes different values, the supported values in the TargetField expression are as follows:
  • body.json: supports key and value
  • cookie: supports key and value
  • header: supports key and value
  • uri.query: supports key and value
  • uri: supports path, query, and fullpath
  • body: supports fullbody and multipart
